# refactor(cli): introduce the composition owner and executable

One slice of the application-boundaries refactor. **Treat this request as self-contained**: everything needed is below and in `docs/specs/application-boundaries.md`. Do not assume access to the parent issue or its siblings.

Lands after the error-ownership issue, and builds on it. The next slices (moving the GitHub code,
then the application API) build on this one and also edit `.dependency-cruiser.mjs`.

## What

The `jig` command starts from one clearly named place that does nothing except assemble the
program and start it. Commands, help and installed usage behave exactly as before.

## Why

Startup and wiring currently live inside the GitHub feature folder, which makes that folder an
extra layer above the command line. A dedicated starting point keeps wiring separate from command
handling and application behavior.

## Context — read this first

jig is a TypeScript CLI that turns a markdown request into planned slices, has agents implement and
review each one in a sandbox, and lands them on one run branch. Source owners under `src/`:
`domain` (business rules), `ports` (external capability contracts), `config` (settings schemas and
policy), `flow`/`steps` (workflow execution), `prompts`, `observers` (events and reporting),
`adapters` (Git, GitHub, files, containers, terminal, logging), `app` (use cases) and `cli` (commands).
Specs sit beside the code they cover (`foo.ts` → `foo.spec.ts`). Before editing, read `AGENTS.md`,
the house rules in `.claude/rules/` that cover the files you change, and `docs/architecture.html`.

This issue implements one part of the design in `docs/specs/application-boundaries.md`. That file is
in the repository; read the sections named below. Where this issue and the spec disagree, follow
the spec and say so in the PR.

## Don't undo these

- Agents run unattended only inside the sandbox. Never add an agent call that runs on the host.
- Credentials never land in a file jig writes, a log line or the image. The one exception:
  `jig init` saves a credential to `.jig/.env` (owner-only, git-ignored) after the operator agrees.
- Nothing touches the target repository's tracked files outside the run's worktree.
- Keep commands, flags, defaults, help, error tags and messages, exit codes, configuration
  precedence and recovery behavior unchanged unless this issue says otherwise.
- Expected failures are `Result` values; bugs panic. jig never throws.
- Keep dependency policy in `.dependency-cruiser.mjs` and `scripts/check-dependencies.mjs`, with
  fixtures in `scripts/check-dependencies.spec.ts`. Do not write another source scanner.
- No release tags and no version bumps; `main` publishes on its own.
- If you change where something lives, update `docs/architecture.html`, `docs/workflow-ownership.md`
  and the code map in `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and any guide that names a moved path. Describe current
  behavior in the present tense.

## Target

Spec sections: "Composition", "Dependency lint", and the `composition` row of "Target responsibilities".

- `src/integrations/github/cli.ts` composes the full CLI and starts the executable. Move executable
  startup and command composition to `src/composition/main.ts`, keeping the realpath check that
  makes installed symlinks work. Importing builders or the module must not start a command.
- `package.json`: `bin.jig`, `main` (`./dist/integrations/github/cli.js`) and `scripts.dev`
  (`tsx src/integrations/github/cli.ts`) point at the new executable. Update path-sensitive tests,
  `tests/e2e/feature.spec.ts`, and `docs/installation.md` line 52.
- Composition may import `app`, `cli`, `adapters`, `config`, `observers`, `ports` and `domain`.
  It only chooses implementations, constructs them and starts the executable. In this slice it
  still calls the existing app container. Leave the container itself alone; a separate spike
  decides how it changes.
- Dependency Cruiser: add `composition` to `productionModules` in `scripts/check-dependencies.mjs`.
  Add the rules "only composition imports `src/cli/` from another owner" and "no other owner
  imports `src/composition/`". The rules cover type-only imports, re-exports and literal dynamic
  imports. `scripts/validate.ts` may keep using CLI parsing helpers; do not let the source-only
  rule break it. Extend `scripts/check-dependencies.spec.ts` with fixtures that accept composition
  importing CLI and reject an adapter, app or nested file importing CLI or composition. Each
  rejection must fail under the named rule, not because of an incidental cycle.
- `src/integrations/github/command.ts` remains a CLI-side command file; the next slice moves it.
  If a temporary edge from `cli` to `integrations` is needed, record it in the PR and do not add a
  forwarding module.

## Done when

- [ ] `node dist/composition/main.js --help` and `node dist/composition/main.js github implement --help`
      work after `npm run build`, and a symlinked executable starts.
- [ ] A spec imports the composition builders without starting a command.
- [ ] Fixtures prove the new rules, including type-only, re-export, dynamic, nested and
      disconnected offenders.
- [ ] Executable paths in `package.json`, the tests and the docs point at `src/composition/main.ts`.
- [ ] The verification below passes.

## Verification

From the repository root using the pinned Node version (`volta` in `package.json`):

```sh
npm run lint:dependencies
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm test
npm run build
npm run format:check
npm run validate -- --skip test:mutation
```

No check may start an agent on the host or publish to GitHub. In the PR, state which owner each
moved concept now belongs to and why.


Source: https://github.com/ygrishajev/jig/issues/57

context.repoSummary: jig is a TypeScript ESM CLI using Commander, Awilix, better-result and colocated Vitest specs; package.json pins Node 26.13.0. src/integrations/github/cli.ts exports buildJigCli(), combines src/cli/main.ts's buildCli() with registerGithubCommands(), and gates parseAsync()/exitWhenDone() behind a realpath comparison for installed symlinks. Existing cli.spec.ts covers command composition and version output. Move executable composition to src/composition/main.ts while preserving import safety, shutdown and command behavior; leave app/container.ts and application lifecycle unchanged. GitHub command.ts currently imports CLI helpers despite remaining under integrations, so enforcing the new owner boundary requires explicitly reconciling this transitional command ownership. Existing GitHub isolation is enforced by .dependency-cruiser.mjs, ESLint and src/boundary.spec.ts; the design calls for removing obsolete isolation checks and the custom scanner. Dependency Cruiser already includes erased imports; scripts/check-dependencies.mjs recursively scans all production files, checks ownership and separately checks runtime cycles. Contrary to the request's location wording, productionModules is currently exported from .dependency-cruiser.mjs, not the script. Extend scripts/check-dependencies.spec.ts's temporary-repository fixtures with named-rule assertions for composition/CLI boundaries, including disconnected, nested, type-only, re-export and dynamic imports; preserve scripts/validate.ts's CLI-helper access. The specification also permits composition to import failures, omitted from the request's list. Update package bin/main/dev paths, tests/e2e/feature.spec.ts, installation instructions, architecture.html, workflow-ownership.md and CONTRIBUTING.md. Validate built help, GitHub help, symlink startup and import safety alongside the requested checks, without running host agents or publishing.

plan.summary: Introduce src/composition/main.ts as the executable and full-program composition owner, preserving commands, import safety, installed symlink handling and shutdown behavior. Update executable references, dependency enforcement, regression coverage and ownership documentation without changing the app container or application lifecycle.
plan.approach: Move buildJigCli and guarded executable startup from integrations/github/cli.ts into composition/main.ts, retaining the shebang, realpath comparison, parseAsync and exitWhenDone ordering. Move its colocated specs and add explicit import-safety and symlink-startup coverage. Keep command declarations and parsing CLI-owned and leave existing app-container usage intact for this slice. Resolve a transitional ownership mismatch before implementation: integrations/github/command.ts imports CLI helpers but must remain at its current path, so a literal folder-based 'only composition imports CLI' rule would reject it. Design must explicitly represent that file as transitional CLI ownership, reconcile its outgoing integrations dependencies and module-cycle accounting, and document any temporary edge; do not exempt all integrations or add a forwarding module. Composition also temporarily needs access to the GitHub command and GithubPort until the next slice redistributes them. Remove obsolete GitHub isolation checks from Dependency Cruiser and overlapping ESLint entries, and remove src/boundary.spec.ts's custom scanner as specified. Add named source-only rules preventing other owners from importing CLI or composition, retaining same-owner access, spec access and scripts/validate.ts helper imports. Preserve recursive production discovery, erased-edge analysis, runtime cycle checks and existing resolution/package checks. Extend temporary-repository fixtures with accepted composition imports and independently failing adapter, app, nested and disconnected offenders using ordinary imports, type imports, re-exports and literal dynamic imports; assert the intended rule names rather than incidental cycles. Two further request/spec mismatches need explicit treatment: productionModules is defined in .dependency-cruiser.mjs, so register composition there rather than duplicating it in the runner; the specification permits composition to import failures, so update that importer policy too. Defer the specification's broader removal of integrations, application API restrictions and container changes to their designated slices. Update package bin/main to dist/composition/main.js and dev to src/composition/main.ts, fix path-sensitive tests and public references, and describe the resulting ownership in the PR. Verify built root help, GitHub implement help, symlink startup and import safety, then run lint:dependencies, lint, typecheck, test, build, format:check and validate -- --skip test:mutation with pinned Node 26.13.0, without host-agent execution or publication.

src/integrations/github/command.ts and src/cli/: transitional command ownership and dependency edges
.dependency-cruiser.mjs: production owners, composition/failures permissions, CLI and composition boundaries, obsolete GitHub isolation
scripts/check-dependencies.mjs and scripts/check-dependencies.spec.ts: preserve analysis pipeline and extend named-rule fixtures
